gaps.explanation: 'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.
